full_judgment:
"(a) Penal Code (XLV of 1860)  ......Section 188... Criminal Procedure Code (V of 1898), Ss. 195(1)(a) & 561A  Quashing of proceedings  Case against accused under S.188, PCC was registered at the instance of a Police Officer for alleged violation of the order of the District Magistrate passed under section 144, CrPC......District Magistrate only being competent to lodge a complaint against the accused under section 195(1)(a), CrPC, proceedings initiated by the said Police Officer were unlawful and the same were quashed accordingly. [pp.590,591] A & C" 

 15. We have considered the facts of the case cited by the learned Advocate for the petitioner that the case was filed by the police officer for alleged violation of the order of the District Magistrate passed under section 144 CrPC, initiation of a complaint case by the police officer is unlawful as a District Magistrate only being competent to lodge a complaint against the accused under section 195(1)(a) of the Code of Criminal Procedure initiated by the police officer were unlawful and the same was quashed accordingly, in view of the fact and circumstances of the case.
